Company description: GS (Generated via gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., trading under the ticker GS, is a leading global financial institution that delivers a wide range of financial services to a substantial and diversified client base. Founded in 1869 by Marcus Goldman in New York City, the firm evolved from a small commercial paper business into a preeminent global investment banking and securities powerhouse. Today, Goldman Sachs operates across four primary segments: investment banking, global markets, asset management, and wealth management. The company provides strategic advisory on mergers and acquisitions, capital-raising services, underwriting, and securities dealing, alongside comprehensive wealth and asset management solutions for corporations, financial institutions, governments, and high-net-worth individuals worldwide.
